method: Complete source/companion/receipt inventory and per-item scope review; exercises and transfer prompts inspected across all phases. Mathematical/code close review and visual inspection are selective, not a proof of every sentence or a novice/expert acceptance.

levels.available-draft: Material is available for its stated practice scope. Teaching review and learner validation are still pending.
levels.in-development: Useful material exists, but important parts of this course or project are still being developed. Read its stated scope before starting.
levels.planned: The full capstone is not yet implemented and qualified. A separately scoped pilot may be available.
levels.needs-repair: Required material is missing or its current checks fail. Do not rely on it until repaired.

findings.title: No independent teaching reviews or novice pilots are recorded
findings.action: Recruit consented novices and independent specialists; bind accepted reports to the exact content hash. Automated execution and this internal audit do not count as human acceptance.

findings.title: All ten larger model and retrieval capstones are specifications
findings.action: Implement one licensed-data, baseline-compared model lineage at a time. Existing tiny pilots and harnesses are preparation, not 300M releases.

findings.title: Hardware evidence is real but narrow
findings.action: Retain the four source-matching v5e receipts and their limits. Add fresh-process/worker-loss recovery, target inference, native quantization and scaling evidence separately.

findings.title: Choice-specific checkpoint reasoning is implemented; learner validation remains open
findings.action: Review the three rationales in every lesson and pilot changed-condition tasks. Author revision is not independent teaching acceptance.

findings.title: Learner-only contracts are authored; independent assessment calibration remains open
findings.action: Review all 305 authored task contracts and pilot unseen transfer cases. Learner-only downloads omit reference solutions and checkpoint answers; this author revision does not establish independent learner success or calibrated grading.

findings.title: Figure freshness is checked but interpretation still needs human review
findings.action: Corrected the two recovery captions: equal leaf norms do not imply elementwise equality, and continuation depends on complete state, inputs, configuration and environment. Human review of arrows, axes, units and causal explanations is still needed.

findings.title: Career routes and duration estimates are not externally calibrated
findings.action: Ask working practitioners to review role coverage and pilot actual learner journeys. Portfolio fixture passes do not establish job readiness.

findings.title: Availability, completion and hardware review were mixed in learner-facing wording
findings.action: Added learner-facing maturity, current CPU checks, scoped hardware evidence and teaching-review status. Replaced stale blanket TPU staging instructions. Keep these labels source-bound as the material changes.
